description: Verify category tree breadcrumb and depth calculation
setupSql:
CREATE TABLE categories (id INT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INT, name VARCHAR(50));
INSERT INTO categories VALUES (1, NULL, 'Electronics'), (2, 1, 'Computers'), (3, 2, 'Laptops'), (4, 1, 'Audio'), (5, 4, 'Headphones');
expectedOutputSql:
WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS (
    SELECT id, parent_id, name, 1 AS depth, name::text AS breadcrumb
    FROM categories WHERE parent_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.name, ct.depth + 1, ct.breadcrumb || ' > ' || c.name
    FROM categories c JOIN category_tree ct ON c.parent_id = ct.id
)
SELECT id, name, depth, breadcrumb FROM category_tree ORDER BY breadcrumb;
